newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks in unofficial record close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks in unofficial record close.

text.p: Mexican stocks fended off a late slump on Wall Street to end up at an unofficial record on Tuesday which, if confirmed, would be the fifth such historic close in a row.
Analysts and dealers said share prices gained on heavy buying by foreign investors following an announcement of strong industrial output data and a debt prepayment by the Mexican government.
Preliminary closing prices placed the leading IPC share index up 11.67 points, or 0.27 percent, at 4,271.51.
